name: Nacogdoches County, TX
findings: Nacogdoches County has 175 nonprofit organizations. 69 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 61 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Nacogdoches County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Nacogdoches County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 36 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
